notes.title: UI, Graphic Update and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
1. UI (User Interface) Updates:
New Menu Design: The game menus have been redesigned with a more modern and user-friendly interface. These updates allow players to navigate through the menus more easily and quickly access the options they are looking for. ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː

Improved In-Game Display Panel: The panel that shows important information such as the score, time, and player details during the game has been made more readable and aesthetically pleasing. This ensures that players can access the information they need more quickly while playing.

2. Graphic Updates:
High-Resolution Graphics: All in-game graphics have been updated with high-resolution and detailed visuals. This enhancement significantly improves the visual quality of the game, providing players with a more satisfying visual experience.

Enhanced Animations: The movements of the ball, the responses of the racket, and the animations of the player characters have been made smoother and more realistic. These improvements create a more natural feel while playing the game.

New Backgrounds and Effects: Various new backgrounds and visual effects have been added to the game arena. These updates enrich the game atmosphere, making each match feel like it's being played in a different setting.


3. Bug Fixes:
Control Issues Resolved: Based on player feedback, some delays and sensitivity issues with the racket's movements have been fixed. These adjustments make the game controls more responsive and user-friendly.

Crash Problems Solved: Rare crashes that occurred during gameplay have been analyzed and resolved. This improvement ensures a more stable and uninterrupted gaming experience.

Graphical Errors Fixed: Issues such as visual distortions and incorrect rendering of graphic elements have been corrected. These fixes enhance the visual consistency and overall quality feel of the game.

Sound Issues Fixed: Errors related to sound effects that appeared in certain situations have been resolved. This ensures that sounds work more accurately and harmoniously during gameplay.
